quest.title: Cooking Showdown
quest.description: After obtaining the rare ingredients, Xiangling is finally ready for the cook-off. The showdown between the two head chefs is about to begin.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x225, Primogem x60, Mora x8475, Teachings of Diligence x5, Adventurer's Experience x4, Fine Enhancement Ore x10

talks.objective: Return to Springvale for the cooking showdown

dialogues.speaker: Olaf
dialogues.text: Uh... Are you sure this is Springvale?

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: Yes. For the millionth time, yes! But I don't know any of the people you're looking for.

dialogues.speaker: Olaf
dialogues.text: That is not possible, they all live in Springvale. They are my neighbors and friends.

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: This is strange, what is going on?

choices.text: Surely, it couldn't be...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What is it?

choices.text: This hunter is also a survivor from 300 years ago.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whaaaat!? Can humans really live that long?

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Er... Does that really make sense?

choices.text: He and the boar were both frozen.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Oh! Like the way that you keep food fresh!

response.speaker: Draff
response.text: Still, it's hard to believe...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But it doesn't seem like there's any other sensible explanation.

response.speaker: Draff
response.text: Okay so... What's your name?

response.speaker: Olaf
response.text: Olaf.

response.speaker: Draff
response.text: Olaf? I'm sure I've seen that on my family tree!

response.speaker: Draff
response.text: I can't remember which generation it was from... but it was definitely on there.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: So, a great-great-great-great grandfather, but with a whole load more greats?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: They don't look so distantly related.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What an unusual turn of events!

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Hee-hee, reunited at long last! Isn't that just amazing!?

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Olaf, do you want to come and watch a cooking competition?

response.speaker: Draff
response.text: Ah yes, that reminds me — Brook told me about the competition, and I've set everything up at the venue.

response.speaker: Draff
response.text: You should come with me.

choices.text: The ice kept him fresh all this time, like with your ingredients.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Hee-hee, it all makes sense now that you're speaking my language!

choices.text: He's talking about Springvale a long, long time in the past.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: How long? ...Surely not hundreds of years!?

choices.text: I think I see what's going on here.

talks.objective: Talk to Xiangling at the Cooking Showdown

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: We're ready to cook. Are you?

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: I was born ready. Oh, and Siegfria will be my assistant for the competition.

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: Then let the cooking commence! I will be your judge today.

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: And don't worry, I may have known Brook for longer, but I will remain entirely impartial.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: #Much appreciated. Well then, {NICKNAME}, Paimon — prepare!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, we're taking part in this too?

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Of course! If Brook has an assistant, you guys will have to be mine. I'll need you by my side when the going gets tough!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: *sigh* Paimon doesn't remember applying for that job...

choices.text: Well, I'm going to see this through.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay. Paimon'll do it for the sake of the food.

choices.text: Ugh, I guess there's no backing out now...

talks.objective: Help Xiangling during the cooking showdown

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Our first problem is ingredients. We need something special to dress up the steak, but I don't have anything suitable here. Hmm...

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: I've got it! Radish is what we need. Mashed or grated, it'll add a touch of freshness.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: And we can carve little flowers out of it as a garnish. Two birds, one stone!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Go find me a radish — there should be some in the area. Oh, and make sure you wash it because it's going straight into the dish!

talks.objective: Go to the lakeside and wash the Radish
Give the washed Radish to Xiangling

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Wowee! Big and luscious. It's perfect. Thanks, you guys!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Now, how about...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Xiangling! Look out, the pan's on fire!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Oh, no! It's gonna burn, it's gonna burn, it's gonna burn!!!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, get the fire under control! Without using water though, or this dish is a goner!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Ugh, this is practically charcoal now... Wah, I'm gonna have to start from scratch.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Also, I'm thinking our main is a little weak... We need to mix it up a bit.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Make me a Chicken-Mushroom Skewer. And make sure it's got that ooh la-la on the outside, then hits you with a cha-ching in the middle!

choices.text: Did not understand that one bit.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Just make it taste <color=#00E1FFFF>friggin' awesome</color>!

choices.text: Paimon, translate for me!

talks.objective: Give the Delicious Chicken-Mushroom Skewer to Xiangling

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: #Mmm! {NICKNAME}, you're a natural!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: The meat is on track, but we're aiming for perfection here and I just think it lacks a certain...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A certain what?

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: A certain... boom shaka-laka!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yes! Definitely needs some boom shaka-laka — or perhaps a little shaka-laka boom-pow!

choices.text: Again, how is this making sense to you!?

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: I just mean it would be a waste of such amazing ingredients to just serve this as-is.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Let me see... Hmm, what would be ideal is some kind of regional specialty.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Regional specialty?

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Yes, something that's native to this area but isn't often used in cooking.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: I don't care if it flies, crawls, or bounces. Even insects I can work with...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, interesting choice...

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Hmm, I'm sure I can make something of it!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright then...

choices.text: Is that really from an obscure Liyue dialect or did you just make it up?

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Thanks, you guys! Now show me what you got!

choices.text: Give cooking ingredients to Xiangling
Let me keep looking...

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Sorry to keep you running back and forth.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: What I need is a living being, one you wouldn't normally cook with.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: It can fly, it can crawl, or it can bounce. Even insects are fair game!

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: It might be a challenge to find... I'm sure you're up to it!

talks.objective: Ask Xiangling if she is satisfied with the ingredients

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Do you really want to add that?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's a little... odd...

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: It'll be fine. This was an excellent find, guys! Now, if you'll excuse me, Chef Xiangling needs to concentrate.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: But I'll be sure to annoy you again if I need anything else, hee-hee!

talks.objective: Competition countdown timer. For calculating score.
Ask Xiangling if she needs any more help

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: I almost forgot — side dish! We need a side dish!

choices.text: Allow me!

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Are you sure it's no trouble?

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Here, take this. I just scrawled it down at the last minute.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: And here are all the ingredients you need.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Is this the <color=#00E1FFFF>recipe</color> for that snack you gave us earlier!?

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Yes, with some minor improvements so it uses up the leftover ingredients from Liyue.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: This is so complicated... How are we supposed to cook this with no experience?

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: The technique doesn't matter — what matters is that you do it with passion! That's what my father taught me.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: And you must be passionate about cooking if you've helped me this much already.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: I trust you guys. I know you'll nail this side dish!

choices.text: Leave it to me.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Confident, I like it!

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Come on, this is the final push!

choices.text: I hope I don't cramp your style...

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Don't be so negative. Cooking is fun! Just relax and enjoy it.

choices.text: You'd make me do it even if I didn't offer...

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Thanks! Hee-hee, you know me too well.

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: Fusion cuisine that blends elements of Mondstadt and Liyue cooking... I am excited.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Are the Jade Parcels ready yet?

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Flavor is key, but you also don't want to take too long over it. Once they're ready, bring them here and I'll serve the dish!

talks.objective: Give the Delicious Jade Parcels to Xiangling

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Mmm! They're so fragrant I could smell them coming a mile away.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: We're all set! And now to serve the meal — this competition is ours!

talks.objective: Talk to Draff and await the results

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: This was a fine feast. I have dined today like I have never dined before.

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: Both chefs' dishes today were nothing short of exceptional. They were true masterpieces. And that is what makes this an extremely difficult decision.

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: But, this is a competition and there can only be one winner — and that winner is...

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: Xiangling!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Whoopee! I win!

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: *sigh* I thought I was sure to win with pork chops so fresh they were practically still grunting.

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: But it turns out that's still no match for the taste of extinct boar.

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: Excuse me? Did you say this was cooked from extinct boar!?

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Yep, every last bit!

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: My goodness... A single mouthful must be worth a hundred thousand Mora!

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: The amount you'd make if you sold this could support every hunter in town for years to come!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Hee-hee, the main thing is that you enjoyed eating it. I don't care about the Mora.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Anyway, now that our judge has given his verdict, it's time for everyone else to eat too. I made plenty!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Meanwhile, I want to try Brook's dish.

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: This is absolutely delicious... I'll admit it, I was beaten by the best.

dialogues.speaker: Siegfria
dialogues.text: Losing is no fun, but it was worth it for the chance to eat such superb cooking! Please Xiangling, I want some more!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: This is gorgeous too! Such a perfectly layered texture.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Were it not for that exquisite boar and excellent side dish, it's hard to say if I still would have won.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's turn to eat!

dialogues.speaker: Olaf
dialogues.text: I will have a taste too.

dialogues.speaker: Olaf
dialogues.text: Oh... My oh my... This is...

dialogues.speaker: Olaf
dialogues.text: This is the taste of Springvale! ...Or rather... it used to be.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It tastes so good I want to weep tears of joy.

dialogues.speaker: Olaf
dialogues.text: *sob* This is the last time I will be able to taste the food of my era...

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Hey now... Cheer up, if you like the taste I can always make you some more!

dialogues.speaker: Olaf
dialogues.text: ...Really? But the boar... it's extinct...

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: The boar may be, but the taste isn't! I can simply recreate it using different ingredients.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Putting a smile on customers' faces is what we chefs are called to do!

dialogues.speaker: Olaf
dialogues.text: Th—Thank you... *sob*

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Thanks, you guys. Without your help, I don't know how it would have gone today.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And without you, Paimon wouldn't have gotten to try so many new tasty snacks!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Also wouldn't have gotten so full...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Where will you go now?

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Not sure. I'll probably start heading back to Liyue, but I might change my plan on the way.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: I don't like to plan things too thoroughly.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Who knows, maybe you'll bump into me out in the wild again!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Must be nice to be so carefree.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: #You are a gifted chef, {NICKNAME}. You made an amazing batch of Jade Parcels.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Come and visit me at the Wanmin Restaurant some time. I did promise I'd cook for you!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: And if you want, I'll teach you how to cook some of my latest inventions too.

choices.text: It's a deal!

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: You have a deal!

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: #Hee-hee, see you again soon, {NICKNAME}!

choices.text: I'll pass on the slime jus though...

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: How did you know what dish I was thinking of!?

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: ♪ Ooh la-la-la, cha-ching cha-ching. Ooh la-la-la, cha-ching cha-ching ♪

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Bring the fire down! It's gonna burn to a crisp!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Go fetch me some radishes. And don't forget to wash them in the lake!

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: What's this? Culinary espionage?

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: Haha, well you don't stand a chance, anyway. I have the winning ingredients right here.

dialogues.speaker: Siegfria
dialogues.text: Smells divine! ...One little bite can't hurt, surely?

dialogues.speaker: Siegfria
dialogues.text: No, I mustn't... I'm here to help... eyes on the prize, eyes on the prize...

dialogues.speaker: Olaf
dialogues.text: I never knew cooking could be so complicated... The roast boar I am used to is quite basic by comparison!
